name: @kitora/scheduling
description: Kitora's scheduling kit: an event calendar (month, week, day, agenda, resource timeline) with drag to move, resize and create, all-day lanes, overlap layout, time zones and RRULE expansion, plus a Gantt chart with dependencies, drag bars, zoom levels and a today line, on a framework-free core.

exports.name: startOfDay
exports.description: Local midnight of the day holding `d`.

exports.name: addDays
exports.description: Adds calendar days, keeping the wall-clock time even across a DST change.

exports.name: addMinutes
exports.description: `d` plus `minutes` of elapsed time (crossing a DST change moves the wall clock).

exports.name: addMonths
exports.description: Adds calendar months, clamping the day (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29).

exports.name: daysInMonth
exports.description: Days in the zero-based `month` of `year`.

exports.name: startOfWeek
exports.description: Local midnight of the first day of the week holding `d`, for weeks that start on `weekStartsOn`.

exports.name: startOfMonth
exports.description: Local midnight of the first day of the month holding `d`.

exports.name: isSameDay
exports.description: Whether `a` and `b` fall on the same local calendar day.

exports.name: diffDays
exports.description: Whole calendar days from a to b (b - a), immune to DST hour shifts.

exports.name: diffMinutes
exports.description: Whole minutes from `a` to `b` (b - a), rounded.

exports.name: minuteOfDay
exports.description: Minutes since local midnight.

exports.name: atMinute
exports.description: The same day at `minutes` past midnight.

exports.name: snap
exports.description: Rounds to the nearest multiple of `step` (in the same unit as `value`).

exports.name: clamp
exports.description: `value` limited to the range `[min, max]`.
exports.signature: (value: number, min: number, max: number) => number

exports.name: dayRange
exports.description: `count` consecutive days from `start`.

exports.name: monthGrid
exports.description: The weeks a month view shows: whole weeks covering the month, as rows of seven days.
exports.signature: (anchor: Date, weekStartsOn?: Weekday, fixedWeeks?: boolean) => Date[][]

exports.name: dayKey
exports.description: Day key `YYYY-MM-DD` of a wall date, for maps and React keys.

exports.name: overlaps
exports.description: Do the half-open ranges [aStart, aEnd) and [bStart, bEnd) share time?
exports.signature: (aStart: Date, aEnd: Date, bStart: Date, bEnd: Date) => boolean

exports.name: MINUTE_MS
exports.description: Milliseconds in a minute.

exports.name: HOUR_MINUTES
exports.description: Minutes in an hour.

exports.name: DAY_MINUTES
exports.description: Minutes in a day.

exports.name: DAY_MS
exports.description: Milliseconds in a day (24 hours, ignoring DST).

exports.name: WEEK_DAYS
exports.description: Days in a week; month grids are always whole weeks.

exports.name: Weekday
exports.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday, the `Date#getDay` numbering.

exports.name: localTimeZone
exports.description: The machine's own zone, the default display zone.

exports.name: isValidTimeZone
exports.description: Is `timeZone` an IANA name this runtime knows?

exports.name: zoneOffset
exports.description: The zone's UTC offset at `instant`, in minutes (New York in winter: -300).

exports.name: toZoned
exports.description: Instant → wall time in `timeZone` (a Date whose local fields read as that zone's clock).

exports.name: fromZoned
exports.description: Wall time in `timeZone` → the instant.

exports.name: zoneLabel
exports.description: Short label for a zone at an instant, e.g. "GMT+5:30" or "EST".
exports.signature: (instant: Date, timeZone: string, locale?: string) => string

exports.name: EVENT_COLORS
exports.description: The colour tokens an event or task may carry; each maps to a palette in ui/styles.ts.

exports.name: EventColor
exports.description: A colour token an event or task can carry, each mapped to a palette.

exports.name: CalendarEvent
exports.description: A calendar event as the host stores it: instants (floating dates when all-day), with optional recurrence, resource and colour.

exports.name: Occurrence
exports.description: One concrete appearance of an event, in display-zone wall time.

exports.name: Resource
exports.description: A row of the resource timeline: a person, room or other bookable thing.

exports.name: CALENDAR_VIEWS
exports.description: The calendar views the kit ships.

exports.name: CalendarView
exports.description: A calendar view: `month`, `week`, `day`, `agenda` or `timeline`.

exports.name: parseRRule
exports.description: Parses an RRULE string (`parseRRuleParts`); returns undefined when FREQ is missing or unknown.

exports.name: formatRRule
exports.description: Serialises a rule back to `FREQ=…;…` (no prefix).

exports.name: expandRRule
exports.description:
Wall-time starts of a series from `dtstart` (itself wall time; always the first occurrence, as
RFC 5545 counts it) up to `before`, honouring COUNT and UNTIL.
exports.signature: (rule: RRule, dtstart: Date, options: ExpandOptions) => Date[]

exports.name: describeRRule
exports.description: A short English summary: "Every 2 weeks on Mon, Wed · 10 times" (`describeRRuleParts`; the UNTIL date as this machine's calendar shows it).

exports.name: MAX_RRULE_PERIODS
exports.description: A safety cap on the periods an expansion walks, so a rule that never matches (BYMONTHDAY=31 every 12 months from February) terminates.

exports.name: WEEKDAY_CODES
exports.description: RRULE weekday codes indexed by `Weekday` (0 = Sunday, the `getUTCDay` numbering).

exports.name: WeekdayCode
exports.description: One of `WEEKDAY_CODES`: an RRULE weekday code (`SU` … `SA`).

exports.name: FREQUENCIES
exports.description: The frequencies a series can repeat at.

exports.name: Frequency
exports.description: How often a series repeats, an RFC 5545 FREQ value.

exports.name: ByDay
exports.description: One BYDAY entry; `nth` 0 = every such weekday in the period, 2 = the second, -1 = the last.

exports.name: RRule
exports.description: A parsed RFC 5545 recurrence rule.

exports.name: ExpandOptions
exports.description: Where expanding a recurrence rule stops and what it skips.

exports.name: expandEvents
exports.description: Every occurrence touching the range, sorted by start then longest first.

exports.name: compareOccurrences
exports.description: Start ascending, then longer first, then title: the order every view lays out in.

exports.name: ExpandRange
exports.description: The visible wall-time range and display zone events are expanded into occurrences for.

exports.name: isAllDayLike
exports.description: Does this occurrence belong in the all-day row rather than the time grid?

exports.name: segmentsForDay
exports.description: Clips timed occurrences to `day`; crossing midnight yields one segment per day.

exports.name: layoutDay
exports.description:
Places overlapping segments side by side: clusters of transitively overlapping segments share a
column count, each segment takes the first free column, then stretches right over columns that
stay free for its whole duration. `minMinutes` is the shortest height a segment is drawn at, so
a 5-minute event that renders 20 minutes tall still pushes its neighbours aside.

exports.name: layoutRow
exports.description:
Packs occurrences over a row of `days` into lanes: earlier and longer bars first, each in the
lowest lane free for its whole span. `include` picks which occurrences the row shows.
exports.signature: (occurrences: readonly Occurrence[], days: readonly Date[], include?: (o: Occurrence) => boolean) => { bars: RowBar[]; lanes: number; }

exports.name: layoutTrack
exports.description: Packs occurrences on one continuous axis into lanes (the resource timeline's rows).
exports.signature: (occurrences: readonly Occurrence[], axisStart: Date, axisEnd: Date) => { bars: TrackBar[]; lanes: number; }

exports.name: DaySegment
exports.description: A timed occurrence clipped to one day column, in minutes since that day's midnight.

exports.name: PlacedSegment
exports.description: A day segment placed in its overlap cluster: its column, the cluster's column count and how far it may stretch.

exports.name: RowBar
exports.description: An occurrence's bar across a row of consecutive days.

exports.name: TrackBar
exports.description: A bar on a continuous time axis (resource timeline), in minutes from the axis start.

exports.name: applyEventChange
exports.description:
Folds a change into the stored events. A one-off event is rewritten in place. For a repeating
event, `series` shifts the whole series by the same offset (and takes the new duration), while
`occurrence` adds an EXDATE to the series and adds a detached copy with id `<id>~<original ISO>`.
exports.signature: (events: readonly CalendarEvent[], change: EventChange, options: { readonly timeZone: string; readonly scope?: EditScope; }) => CalendarEvent[]

exports.name: removeOccurrence
exports.description: Removes one occurrence (EXDATE) or the whole event.
exports.signature: (events: readonly CalendarEvent[], occurrence: Occurrence, scope?: EditScope) => CalendarEvent[]

exports.name: moveRange
exports.description: Shifts a wall range by whole minutes, keeping its duration.
exports.signature: (start: Date, end: Date, deltaMinutes: number) => { start: Date; end: Date; }

exports.name: moveRangeDays
exports.description: Shifts a wall range by whole days, keeping wall-clock times.
exports.signature: (start: Date, end: Date, deltaDays: number) => { start: Date; end: Date; }

exports.name: resizeRange
exports.description: Drags one edge to `to`, never letting the range shrink below `minMinutes` or invert.
exports.signature: (start: Date, end: Date, edge: "start" | "end", to: Date, minMinutes: number) => { start: Date; end: Date; }

exports.name: rangeBetween
exports.description: The range between two pointed-at slots, in either drag direction; each point is a slot start.
exports.signature: (a: Date, b: Date, slotMinutes: number) => { start: Date; end: Date; }

exports.name: minuteAtOffset
exports.description: A vertical pixel offset in a day column → snapped minute of the day.
exports.signature: (offsetPx: number, pxPerMinute: number, snapMinutes: number, startMinute?: number, endMinute?: number) => number

exports.name: slotAtOffset
exports.description: Floors a minute offset to its slot, for picking the slot under the pointer.
exports.signature: (offsetPx: number, pxPerMinute: number, slotMinutes: number, startMinute?: number, endMinute?: number) => number

exports.name: EDIT_SCOPES
exports.description: How a change to one occurrence of a repeating event lands.

exports.name: EditScope
exports.description: How a change to a repeating event lands: on one `occurrence` or on the whole `series`.

exports.name: CHANGE_KINDS
exports.description: What the user did to an occurrence.

exports.name: ChangeKind
exports.description: What the user did to an occurrence: `move`, `resize-start`, `resize-end` or `keyboard`.

exports.name: EventChange
exports.description: One edit to an occurrence in display-zone wall time, from a drag, resize or key; `applyEventChange` folds it into stored events.

exports.name: SlotSelection
exports.description: A new range drawn on the calendar (drag to create, click an empty slot).

exports.name: ganttScale
exports.description: The axis over all tasks (and today), aligned to whole units of the zoom.

exports.name: rollupTasks
exports.description: Parents span their children: start = earliest child start, end = latest child end, progress = duration-weighted.

exports.name: visibleRows
exports.description: Depth-first rows in input order, skipping children of collapsed parents.

exports.name: dependencyLinks
exports.description: Every finish-to-start link whose both ends exist.

exports.name: dependencyPath
exports.description:
The SVG path of an arrow from the end of one bar to the start of another (row centres y1, y2).
When the successor starts right of the predecessor's end it is a single elbow; otherwise the line
steps out, drops to the gap between the rows, runs back and steps in.
exports.signature: (x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, rowHeight: number, stub?: number) => string

exports.name: autoSchedule
exports.description:
Moves successors later so every finish-to-start link holds, cascading down the chain; tasks that
already satisfy their links never move, and nothing is ever pulled earlier. Cycles are ignored.

exports.name: successorsOf
exports.description: Ids of every task downstream of `id` through dependencies, for highlighting a chain.

exports.name: siblingGroup
exports.description: The sibling group a task reorders within: its parent id, or {@link ROOT_GROUP} for top-level tasks.

exports.name: reorderSiblings
exports.description:
Rewrites the order of one sibling group (the tasks sharing `group`) to `orderedIds`, leaving every
other task where it is: the group's slots in the array are refilled in the new order.
exports.signature: (tasks: readonly GanttTask[], group: string, orderedIds: readonly string[]) => GanttTask[]

exports.name: GanttTask
exports.description: One task row of a Gantt chart: a dated bar or milestone, with progress, parent and dependencies.

exports.name: GANTT_ZOOMS
exports.description: The zoom levels a Gantt chart offers, from widest days to narrowest.

exports.name: GanttZoom
exports.description: A Gantt zoom level: `day`, `week` or `month`.

exports.name: GANTT_DAY_WIDTH
exports.description: Pixel width of one day at each zoom: wide enough to read a day label, narrow enough for a quarter on screen.

exports.name: HeaderCell
exports.description: One cell of a Gantt header tier, with its label and horizontal position.

exports.name: GanttScale
exports.description: A Gantt chart's horizontal scale: its date span, date ↔ x mapping and two header tiers.

exports.name: ScaleOptions
exports.description: The zoom, padding and locale a Gantt scale is built with.

exports.name: GanttRow
exports.description: A row of the visible task tree.

exports.name: DependencyLink
exports.description: A finish-to-start arrow between two tasks, flagged when the successor starts too early.

exports.name: ROOT_GROUP
exports.description: The sibling group key of a task: its parent id, or ROOT_GROUP for top-level tasks.

exports.name: viewRange
exports.description: The days `view` shows around `date`: the month grid, the week, the day, the agenda span or the timeline span.
exports.signature: (view: CalendarView, date: Date, options?: ViewOptions) => ViewRange

exports.name: stepDate
exports.description: The anchor after one press of Previous (-1) or Next (+1).
exports.signature: (view: CalendarView, date: Date, direction: 1 | -1, options?: ViewOptions) => Date

exports.name: viewTitle
exports.description: "October 2026", "Oct 12 – 18, 2026", "Thursday, Oct 15, 2026" (the default formatter's title).
exports.signature: (view: CalendarView, date: Date, range: ViewRange, locale?: string) => string

exports.name: ViewOptions
exports.description: The week start and day counts that decide which days a view shows.

exports.name: DEFAULT_AGENDA_DAYS
exports.description: Days the agenda view lists when `agendaDays` is not set.

exports.name: ViewRange
exports.description: The days a view shows for an anchor date, as a wall-time range and the list of days.

exports.name: intlFormatter
exports.description: The default formatter, on `Intl.DateTimeFormat`. Formatters are built once per call, so memoise the result.

exports.name: CalendarFormatter
exports.description: Formats wall-time dates (already in the display zone) into the strings the views draw.

exports.name: IntlFormatterOptions
exports.description: The locale and clock {@link intlFormatter} formats with.

exports.name: arrayEventSource
exports.description: The default source: a fixed list, returned whole (views clip to the range).

exports.name: SourceRange
exports.description: The range a calendar is showing: wall time in `timeZone` (start inclusive, end exclusive).

exports.name: EventSource
exports.description: Loads the events that may appear in a range. Returning extra events is fine: views clip them.

exports.name: startGesture
exports.description: Starts tracking from a pointerdown; returns a function that aborts the gesture.
exports.signature: (down: { readonly clientX: number; readonly clientY: number; readonly pointerId: number; }, callbacks: GestureCallbacks) => () => void

exports.name: DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX
exports.description: Pixels the pointer must travel before a press counts as a drag rather than a click.

exports.name: GestureCallbacks
exports.description: The callbacks and options of a pointer drag gesture started by `startGesture`.

exports.name: useCalendar
exports.description: Calendar navigation state, controlled or uncontrolled: the view, the anchor date, its range and title, and the Previous / Today / Next steps.

props.description: The task selected first when uncontrolled.

props.name: onTasksReorder
props.description: Drag a row's grip to reorder it among its siblings. Absent = no grips.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Ids of the collapsed parent tasks (controlled, with `onCollapsedChange`); uncontrolled from `defaultCollapsed` when omitted.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Ids of the parent tasks collapsed first when uncontrolled; none when unset.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called when a parent task is collapsed or expanded, with the new set of collapsed ids.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each row in pixels.

props.name: listWidth
props.description: Width of the task list; 0 hides it.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the header and date labels; the runtime's when unset.

props.name: weekStartsOn
